scope: 4 seasons x day/dawn/dusk/night illustrated scenes and 5 transparent weather overlays
source_policy: Existing furnishings guide only style. Earlier day scenes guide only large composition and season. Each dawn/dusk/night scene directly edits its corresponding new unapproved124day native; no lighting variant is a parent. Existing122/123 artwork is preserved.
prompt_policy: Actual request prompt text is preserved verbatim. Absolute reference locations are represented only by repo-relative frozen-input and native-source lineage. Raw user feedback, session and operational identifiers are excluded.
input_distribution: Frozen references are identified for lineage only and are not distributed in this delivery. The safe66-file delivery is21native PNGs,21final PNGs,21runtime WebPs,one contact sheet and two public records.
original_vs_derivative: generation.original is the unaltered model-call PNG. final is a separately retained512x384 PNG. runtime is its WebP encoding. Scene and lighting changes are generated pixels, not a recoloring derivative.
creator_observation: Generation receipts record whole builtin outputs displayed and observed by their creator. This is not independent art review or user visual approval.

One full-bleed opaque horizontal4:3 image.
